dragonborn.name: Draconic Ancestry
dragonborn.summary: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits as well as your appearance.

dragonborn.name: Breath Weapon
dragonborn.summary: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time).

dragonborn.name: Damage Resistance
dragonborn.summary: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

dragonborn.name: Darkvision
dragonborn.summary: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

dragonborn.name: Draconic Flight
dragonborn.summary: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition.

dwarf.name: Darkvision
dwarf.summary: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

dwarf.name: Dwarven Resilience
dwarf.summary: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

dwarf.name: Dwarven Toughness
dwarf.summary: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

dwarf.name: Stonecunning
dwarf.summary: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense.

elf.name: Darkvision
elf.summary: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

elf.name: Elven Lineage
elf.summary: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

elf.name: Fey Ancestry
elf.summary: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

elf.name: Keen Senses
elf.summary: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

elf.name: Trance
elf.summary: You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

gnome.name: Darkvision
gnome.summary: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

gnome.name: Gnomish Cunning
gnome.summary: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

gnome.name: Gnomish Lineage
gnome.summary: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage): Forest Gnome.

goliath.name: Giant Ancestry
goliath.summary: You are descended from Giants. Choose one of the following benefits—a supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest: Cloud’s Jaunt (Cloud Giant).

goliath.name: Large Form
goliath.summary: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you’re in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required).

goliath.name: Powerful Build
goliath.summary: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

halfling.name: Brave
halfling.summary: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

halfling.name: Halfling Nimbleness
halfling.summary: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can’t stop in the same space.

halfling.name: Luck
halfling.summary: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

halfling.name: Naturally Stealthy
halfling.summary: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

human.name: Resourceful
human.summary: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

human.name: Skillful
human.summary: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

human.name: Versatile
human.summary: You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see “Feats”). Skilled is recommended.

orc.name: Adrenaline Rush
orc.summary: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

orc.name: Darkvision
orc.summary: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

orc.name: Relentless Endurance
orc.summary: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

tiefling.name: Darkvision
tiefling.summary: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

tiefling.name: Fiendish Legacy
tiefling.summary: You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a legacy from the Fiendish Legacies table. You gain the level 1 benefit of the chosen legacy.

tiefling.name: Otherworldly Presence
tiefling.summary: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.
